text: Level three, question six: how much pure milk must be added to thirty litres of a mixture that is sixty percent milk to make it seventy-five percent? Question seven: milk to water is two to one in one vessel and four to one in another; in what ratio must they be mixed to get three to one? Question eight: a forty litre mixture has milk and water in the ratio three to one; how much water must be added to make it two to one?
